name: Itissalat Al-Maghrib (IAM) S.A.
summary: Itissalat Al-Maghrib (IAM) S.A. provides various telecommunication solutions in Morocco and internationally. It operates through Mobile Telephony, Fixed Line Telephony, and Internet segments. The company provides telephony services, including voice and data, as well as broadband Internet access to private customers, businesses and the public sector; and prepaid and postpaid services. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Rabat, Morocco. Itissalat Al-Maghrib (IAM) S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Société de Participation dans les Télécommunications.
